content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

The prototype of Audi's new sports car has car lovers raving. The steering system may still need a bit of tweaking, as the car jack-knifes at higher speeds, and surely you'll want to be speeding a lot with that beauty. But aside from that the car caters to pretty much every wish.
What is the relation between "The steering system may still need a bit of tweaking," and "as the car jack-knifes at higher speeds," from the above essay? Choose from following options 1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
